# Ollama Cloud Free vs Pro — Usage Limits, Pricing & What You Actually Get (2026)

Author: Amaresh Pelleti (DevOps/Cloud engineer, devtoolhub.com)
Published: 2026

## What Ollama Cloud Is
Managed inference service running large open-source models on datacenter GPUs. Same CLI/API as local Ollama — ollama run gpt-oss:120b-cloud.

## Three Tiers
| Feature | Free | Pro | Max |
|---------|------|-----|-----|
| Price | $0 | $20/mo ($200/yr) | $100/mo |
| Cloud usage | Base quota | ~50x Free | Highest |
| Concurrent models | Limited | 3 | More |
| Model access | Lighter cloud models | Full catalog | Full catalog + priority |

Running models on own hardware always unlimited.

## Usage Measurement
- Not fixed token or request cap — GPU time based
- Two reset clocks: session (5h), weekly (7d)
- Four usage levels from 1 (gpt-oss:20b) to 4 (deepseek-v4-pro)
- Free tier: stick to level 1-2 models to stretch quota
- Concurrency queueing with fixed queue depth; requests rejected when queue full

## Privacy
Prompt/response never logged or trained on. Zero-data-retention policies from hosting partners.

## Tier Recommendations
- Free: experimenting with large models that won't fit locally (level 1-2)
- Pro ($20/mo): daily engineering work; most individual devs never hit limits
- Max ($100/mo): production agent and RAG workloads needing sustained concurrent access

## Warning
Ollama has revised cloud quotas more than once since launch. Author bookmarks official page for updates.

## User Comment (Praveen Veera, AI Architect, Jul 1)
Asked about team-oriented features: per-user/project usage views, spending limits, audit logs, centralized team access management — "these controls are often what determine whether a team can use it in production"
